reasoning: The 90-day SOFR average is a backward-looking compounded average. The Fed raised rates to 3.75-4.00% on September 16, 2026, and markets expect rates unchanged at the October 27-28 meeting (80% probability). Between October 11 and October 18, the 90-day window shifts by 7 days, dropping older (likely lower) rates from before the September hike and adding more recent post-hike rates. Since the September rate increase is still being incorporated into the 90-day average, the average should continue rising slightly as more post-hike days enter the calculation window.
